Item Class: Misc Map Items
Rarity: Currency
Inscribed Ultimatum
--------
Challenge: Defeat waves of enemies
Area Level: 83
Requires Sacrifice: Monochrome x2
Reward: Doubles sacrificed Divination Cards
--------
Stormcaller Runes II
(Large runes will appear that will call deadly Lightning storms if you remain in them)
Blistering Cold IV
(Many frozen pustules will periodically appear, chill you, and rapidly explode when you approach, freezing if they hit)
Less Cooldown Recovery
(Cooldowns take five times longer to recharge)
Escalating Monster Speed
(Monsters gain 5% increased attack, cast, and movement speed per second they are alive, up to 50%)
Hindering Flasks
(Using a Flask Hinders you by 50% for 4 seconds)
Lethal Rare Monsters
(Rare Monsters have 2 additional Modifiers)
Deadly Monsters
(Monster Hits are always Critical Strikes)
20% increased Monster Damage
70% more Monster Life
--------
Can be used in a personal map device to open portals to the Trialmaster's Domain and attempt his challenge. Portals will close once the challenge begins. While viewing your Atlas, Right-click this item to pinpoint its location.
